description: session-objective 2.0: one objective file per session, split three ways. [UserPromptSubmit] append the operator's message to the append-only ledger verbatim, then rewrite the OBJECTIVE layer with an interpreter call whose only input is that ledger — no doctrine, no project, no session — and inject OBJECTIVE plus PROGRESS || [PreToolUse, every tool] deny any write whose result changes a byte of the LEDGER or the OBJECTIVE; validate the PROGRESS layer the write would leave on disk; allow a Read of this session's own objective file || [Stop] refuse to end a turn while STATUS is ACTIVE (bounded at 3), refuse a WAITING with nothing in flight, refuse a NEEDS-DECISION whose question was never asked, and refuse a COMPLETE whose D-item proofs do not reproduce or whose objective still lags the ledger || [SessionStart] re-inject on startup, resume and compact; archive and start empty on clear || [SubagentStart] seed the subagent's own file from the parent's OBJECTIVE layer with an empty ledger
